name: Agnes Video V2.0
description: Public YLCraft connector preset for Agnes Video V2.0 text-to-video. Add your own API key after import.

connectors.name: Agnes Video V2.0 Text to Video
connectors.description: Agnes Video V2.0 asynchronous text-to-video and image-to-video. The official gateway is api.agnes-ai.cn. Image-to-video requires a publicly reachable image URL; YLCraft uploads the first frame to the configured COS bucket automatically.
connectors.request_template: {"model":"{{ model }}","prompt":"{{ prompt }}"{% if start_image %},"image":"{{ start_image }}","mode":"ti2vid"{% endif %},"height":{{ height }},"width":{{ width }},"num_frames":{{ num_frames }},"frame_rate":{{ fps }}}

provider_constraints.image_to_video: Requires a publicly reachable image URL; YLCraft uploads the first frame to COS.
